summary: Frontend regression for Odoo Sync 'Sync Now' button bug fix — VERIFIED. Login as admin, navigated to Admin > Migration tab. sync-card renders, sync-now-button enabled ('Sync Now'). Clicking it OPENS the sync-confirm-modal (core bug fix confirmed). Cancel closes modal cleanly. Reopening + clicking 'Yes, Sync Now' fires POST /api/admin/sync/start, shows 'Sync started — fetching changes since …' toast, closes modal, button switches to 'Sync in progress…' (disabled), and sync-progress panel shows 'Syncing… (window: …)'. sync-info fields (Last lead activity in CRM / Last chatter message / Last sync run / Next sync covers) all render correctly with values. No regressions observed.
critical_code_review_comments: Admin.jsx is ~1700+ lines — consider splitting the OdooSync/Migration section into its own component for maintainability.
context_for_next_testing_agent: sync-card lives on Admin > Migration tab (not top level of Admin). Click the 'Migration' tab button first. sync-info element renders only after GET /api/admin/sync/status resolves — allow ~1s before asserting its presence. Sync starts a real Odoo XML-RPC delta; the transition to 'Sync in progress…' + progress panel is a sufficient pass signal without waiting for completion.
